claims.claim: Amendment 3 to the Contracts Law (General Part) rewrote Section 25(a) (third reading 2026-01-05), narrowing the Apropim interpretation rule to COMMERCIAL contracts only; non-commercial, standard-form, and employment contracts stay under the prior Apropim rule. It is a statute, not a case-law reversal.

claims.claim: Severance Pay Law 1963: one month's salary per year of employment; the Section 14 arrangement substitutes pension-fund deposits for severance and is near-universal for new employees.

claims.claim: Privacy Protection Law Amendment 13 (in force 2025-08-14): per-offense administrative fines NIS 1,000 to 320,000, doubled in severe cases (up to ~640,000), separate per-data-subject statutory damages up to NIS 100,000 without proof of harm, a 5% of annual turnover cap in the most serious cases. DPO grace period ended 2025-10-31.

An early Amendment-13 enforcement action was a NIS 75,000 administrative fine on an individual for unauthorized retrieval of data from National Insurance Institute (Bituach Leumi) databases (NOT a fine on HOT).
